data.one_liner: Ethereum JSON RPC 2.0 client for Dart
data.what_it_does: Provides a client to access the Ethereum JSON RPC API. It maps Ethereum RPC data types to Dart types and supports HTTP and WebSocket communication.
use_when: You need to interact with an Ethereum node via JSON RPC in a Dart or Flutter app
You prefer a lightweight client without heavy abstractions
avoid_when: You require full admin API support
You are already using a higher-level library like web3dart
strengths: Cross‑platform support (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux)
Supports both HTTP and WebSocket endpoints
Maps RPC types to native Dart types
weaknesses: No code generation or declarative patterns

alternatives.name: web3dart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Higher‑level abstraction, more complete admin support, and a larger community
